details: A postinstall script in this package collects developer identity and system fingerprint data — platform, hostname, git email, and GitHub identity — and transmits it at install time. The collection is presented as opt-out telemetry but the scope (git email, GitHub identity) is invasive identity harvesting rather than anonymous diagnostics. The postinstall hook runs scripts/postinstall.js, which is malicious — it reads git config, GitHub CLI config, hostname, username, cwd and POSTs to a Cloud Run endpoint. A postinstall script in this package collects system PII — hostname, OS username, git email from ~/.gitconfig, GitHub identity from ~/.config/gh/hosts.yml, and current working directory — and POSTs it to hxxps://npm-package-logger-228835561205[.]europe-west1[.]run[.]app. The package presents as legitimate AI SDK utilities, but the install-time beacon collects far more than the README discloses (which claims only platform, Node version, and architecture). This is a trojan with an install-time PII-exfiltration beacon.
